explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. The downstream priorities all have upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values (s01, s02, etc.) instead of the retained demand record IDs (n06-r01, n06-r02, etc.). The supplied function source localizes this to upstream assemble_provenance, which appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', '')}. This violates the requirement to preserve record_id and deterministic upstream provenance identities, causing downstream ranking to lose the upstream order.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values 's01' through 's08' while needs contain record_id values 'n06-r01' through 'n06-r08'.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, demonstrating the provenance ranks did not join to coverage record IDs.

assemble_provenance source sets records.append({'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}), replacing the demand record identity with the source identity.
